basic_info.description: A flawless reinvention of a classic Marina-style barrel front home, 1366 35th Ave is a masterclass in design, craftsmanship, and livability. Rebuilt to the studs with fully permitted work, this 3 bed, 3 bath Central Sunset home offers timeless charm with every modern convenience. Inside, every surface and system has been renovated. Level 5 smooth walls, quiet rock insulation, laundry on each level and custom finishes reflect the thoughtfulness of the renovation. The kitchen is a centerpiece, anchored by a 9-ft Cambria quartz island, top-tier Wolf/Sub-Zero appliances, and custom cabinetry. Three designer bathrooms offer spa-like comfort with towel warmers, quartz counters, and rain showers. Downstairs, a spacious second en suite bedroom, laundry and mudroom, and oversized garage with EV charging capability, built-in cabinetry, and storage offer flexibility and function. All-new 200amp electrical, copper plumbing, tankless water heater, seismic upgrades, and heat pumps with A/C mean you can move in without lifting a finger. The backyard is a retreat: tiered lawn, patio, gas fire pit, and landscape lighting. This is not a flip, it's a no-compromise, turnkey home, lovingly designed for long-term living.
